title.narrative: The activities in the 2026-2027 Workplan for Dar es Salaam Field Office are designed to support implementation of IHP IX

description.narrative: The Workplan covers activities focusing on collating previous studies related to water sciences conducted at the basin level and coming up with summary report that would propose already available data and results from the previous studies sitting at the basin water boards shelves and the existing data and information gap. The study would help the authorities to align the current studies to address issues that had never been addressed and avoiding duplication resources and effort. The workplan also focuses on bringing together members of the academia and industry in the water sector with focus on basin level water management authorities and research institutions to dialogue on research areas where the studies can focus on in addressing basin level management challenges and bridging the data gap in supporting decision making on water management and use. As well the workplan will support ecohydrology related trainings in collaboration with UNESCO Chair in Ecohydrology and transboundary water management at the Sokoine University of Agriculture and all IHP related activities will be supported at the National level.
